Telehealth Mental Health Care | PMHNP Online Therapy & Medication Management
Personalized psychiatric support from a dedicated PMHNP — all from the comfort of your home.
Now accepting new patients | Secure & confidential virtual visits
At LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry, I provide professional, compassionate, and confidential telehealth mental health care through secure and convenient virtual services. I am Lourdie Chachoute, NP, APRN, PMHNP-BC, a dual-certified Family Nurse Practitioner and Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner with over 15 years of diverse clinical experience.
My approach focuses on personalized treatment, thoughtful medication management, and holistic care that supports both emotional and physical well-being. I specialize in treating anxiety, depression, ADHD, trauma-related conditions, sleep disorders, and mood concerns, while also integrating women’s health and chronic disease support. I develop individualized treatment plans designed to help you feel heard, supported, and empowered on your journey toward long-term mental wellness.
My Services
Specialized telehealth services tailored to meet your unique mental health needs.
How It Works
Getting started is simple. Follow these three easy steps to begin your mental wellness journey.
Are You in Danger?
Please call 988 or use this service to get immediate help.
1
Schedule your appointment online through my secure booking system and choose a date and time that works best for you.
2
You will meet with me through a secure telehealth platform, allowing you to receive care from the comfort and privacy of your home.
3
Receive a tailored treatment plan, medication management (if needed), and ongoing support to help you move forward with confidence.
We believe in transparent and accessible care. I accept select insurance plans and also offer self-pay options.
testimonials
Real experiences from individuals who have trusted us with their mental health care.
“Extremely present and responsive team of providers. You can feel they are here to help you improve your quality of life, whether that is working to find a medication with them or continuing therapy and alternative life changes outside of this practice.”
“Working with my therapist has completely changed how I handle stress and anxiety. For the first time in years, I feel like I have practical tools that genuinely help me stay grounded. Every session gives me clarity and a sense of calm I didn’t think was possible.”
Elisa Smith 
“I came to therapy feeling lost and unsure of how to move forward after a difficult period in my life. My therapist created such a safe space where I could express myself without fear or judgment. Over time, I gained confidence, learned new coping skills, and began to see possibilities again.”
Sofia Taylor
“At first, I wasn’t sure if therapy would help me. But each session opened my eyes to patterns I didn’t even realize were affecting my life. I’ve learned to set healthier boundaries, manage my thoughts better, and treat myself with more compassion.”
Marco Davies

Schedule Your Consultation Today
Take the first step toward better mental health with secure and personalized telehealth support tailored to your needs.
Short Biography
I am a dual-certified Family Nurse Practitioner and Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner dedicated to providing compassionate, holistic, and evidence-based care. My philosophy is simple: mental health is health. I believe true wellness requires caring for the whole person — mind and body — in a safe, respectful, and judgment-free environment where you feel heard and supported.
With over 15 years of diverse clinical experience in critical care, primary care, respiratory therapy, and mental health, I bring a well-rounded perspective to patient care. I specialize in diagnosing and treating anxiety, depression, ADHD, mood disorders, trauma-related conditions, and sleep disturbances. I also integrate women’s health support, weight management, and chronic disease management into my practice, allowing me to address both emotional and physical health needs in a coordinated way.
I earned my Bachelor of Science in Nursing from the University of Central Florida, my Master of Science in Nursing from South University, and a post-master’s certificate from Walden University. I am currently pursuing my Doctor of Nursing Practice degree to further enhance the quality of care I provide.
My approach combines comprehensive evaluation, thoughtful medication management, lifestyle guidance, and patient education. I work collaboratively with you to develop a personalized treatment plan focused on resilience, balance, and long-term well-being.

Provide clear and readable website content
Maintain consistent navigation throughout the website

Provide alternative text for important images

Our telehealth platform is designed to be accessible across multiple devices, including computers, tablets, and smartphones. Virtual sessions can be accessed from home, providing flexibility and convenience.
If you require accommodations to participate in telehealth services, please contact us in advance so appropriate arrangements can be made.

If you experience difficulty accessing any part of this website or need assistance, please contact us. We will make every reasonable effort to provide the information or support you need.

7 Essential Benefits for Safe Treatment
Telehealth Psychiatric Medication Management for Safe and Personalized Treatment
Psychiatric medication management plays an important role in treating many mental health conditions, including anxiety, depression, ADHD, mood disorders, and sleep disturbances. While medications can significantly improve symptoms and quality of life, effective treatment requires careful evaluation, monitoring, and ongoing adjustment.
As a dual-certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) and Family Nurse Practitioner, I provide comprehensive medication management for adults through secure telehealth appointments. My goal is to ensure that every medication prescribed is appropriate for your diagnosis, effective in reducing symptoms, and safe for your overall health.
Medication management is not simply about prescribing medication. It is an ongoing process that includes evaluating your symptoms, monitoring progress, managing side effects, and making adjustments when necessary. I work closely with you to ensure you understand your treatment and feel confident in your care plan.
Every treatment decision is personalized based on your medical history, symptoms, and individual goals.
When Medication Management May Help
Medication management may be beneficial if you have been diagnosed with a mental health condition or are experiencing symptoms that interfere with your daily functioning.
You may benefit from medication management if you are experiencing:
Persistent anxiety or excessive worry
Depression or low mood
ADHD symptoms such as difficulty focusing
Mood instability or mood swings
Panic attacks
Sleep problems or insomnia
Emotional distress affecting daily life
Difficulty functioning at work or home
Previous medication that is not working effectively
Side effects from current medications
Medication management is also important if you are starting a new medication, adjusting an existing medication, or returning to treatment after a period without care.
Regular monitoring helps ensure your treatment remains effective and safe over time.
What My Medication Management Services Include
My medication management services are structured to provide comprehensive, safe, and individualized care.
Medication Initiation and Adjustment
If medication is appropriate, I carefully select and prescribe medications based on your diagnosis, medical history, and treatment goals.
I monitor your response and adjust dosage or medication as needed to improve effectiveness and minimize side effects.
This process ensures your treatment remains aligned with your evolving needs.
Ongoing Symptom Evaluation
Mental health symptoms can change over time. During follow-up appointments, I assess your emotional, cognitive, and physical symptoms to determine how well your treatment is working.
This helps ensure continued progress and stability.
Monitoring for Side Effects
All medications have potential side effects. I monitor your physical and emotional response to medication and make adjustments if necessary to protect your safety and comfort.
Your well-being is always the priority.
Medication Education and Guidance
I provide clear information about:
How your medication works
Expected benefits
Possible side effects
What to expect during treatment
Safe medication use
Understanding your treatment helps you feel confident and empowered in your care.
Types of Medications I May Prescribe
Depending on your diagnosis and clinical needs, medications may include:
Antidepressants
Used to treat depression, anxiety disorders, and certain trauma-related conditions. These medications help regulate mood and improve emotional stability.
Mood Stabilizers
Mood stabilizers help manage mood swings, bipolar disorder, and emotional instability.
ADHD Medications
When clinically appropriate and compliant with state regulations, ADHD medications may be prescribed to improve focus, attention, and executive functioning.
Anti-Anxiety Medications
These medications help reduce anxiety symptoms, panic attacks, and excessive worry.
Sleep Support Medications
Sleep medications may be used to help regulate sleep patterns and improve overall mental health.
All medication decisions are based on clinical evaluation, safety considerations, and evidence-based guidelines.
Secure Telehealth Medication Management
All medication management appointments are conducted through secure, HIPAA-compliant telehealth platforms. This allows you to receive professional psychiatric care without needing to travel.
Telehealth medication management offers:
Convenient access to care
Flexible scheduling
Increased privacy
Ongoing treatment continuity
Access from home or private location
Telehealth provides the same clinical quality as in-person care while improving accessibility.
Importance of Ongoing Monitoring
Mental health treatment is an ongoing process. Regular follow-up appointments allow me to monitor your progress and ensure your treatment remains effective.
Follow-up visits may include:
Reviewing symptom improvement
Evaluating medication effectiveness
Monitoring side effects
Adjusting treatment if needed
Providing ongoing support
Consistent monitoring improves outcomes and helps prevent complications.
Benefits of Professional Medication Management
Working with a qualified psychiatric provider for medication management provides important benefits:
Safe and accurate prescribing
Reduced risk of side effects
Improved symptom control
Personalized treatment plans
Better long-term mental health outcomes
Ongoing professional support
Increased stability and quality of life
Medication management helps ensure your treatment remains effective and aligned with your needs.
